subject: MARS journal growth and after-hours scan inventory

limitations: Writers remained active. Aggregation and follow-up count/database statistics were separate reads, not a quiesced or transactionally consistent backup.
Stored bytes are the sum of BSON document sizes, excluding collection indexes. They are not on-disk compressed storage or total cluster quota usage.
Original byte totals for compressed records are declared archive metadata; this aggregate did not decompress payloads or independently verify original hashes.
Event dates describe recorded event times, not insertion times or a measured constant ingestion rate.
Absence of a top-level trade_id is not proof that a scan decision has no trade reference elsewhere. Its decision_id may be referenced by trades, open positions or research.

verification.followup_note: The later independent count increased by 400; this confirms active appends rather than a frozen inventory.

database_stats_separate_followup.note: A later sourceborn-only read; no new cluster-wide total was measured in this inventory.

comparison_to_dated_inventory.note: Endpoint comparison only; not a growth forecast or proof that only inserts occurred between dates.

limitations: Archive compressed query metadata retains mode but not gates/outcome. Archived outcomes were not decoded or inferred.
The separately read current portfolio tail contains only 156 recent Intraday observations; its blocked/unavailable results cannot be generalized to all 3231 archived observations.
The recent windows are UTC and span only a portion of ongoing overnight work. Counts are not complete scan-run totals.
evidence: 3231 archived SCAN_DECISION records totaling 6397077 BSON bytes have event timestamps within the measured 15-minute overnight window; all carry zlib/v1 markers.
The current portfolio RAM tail has 156 Intraday SCAN_DECISION records, all blocked with history and intraday_data unavailable.
Two archived SCAN_CATCHUP records since18:00 UTC classify their trigger as startup. Their timestamps are approximately120 seconds after the two Render startup-complete observations.
Three MARKET_CLOSED_NO_ENTRY and three ROTATION_MARKET_CLOSED archive markers were observed since18:00 UTC.
after_hours_observation.inference: Existing startup catch-up behavior is an evidenced generator of after-hours journal data. These metadata-only reads do not identify every scan invocation or establish that every new byte came from catch-up, and they do not prove the full entry/exit ledger.

code_paths.all_candidate_decisions: trading/engine.py: scan() journals every decisions.values() result
code_paths.startup_delay: web/scheduler.py: start_scheduler() schedules catchup_scan_if_missed('startup') after120 seconds
code_paths.after_hours_policy: web/scheduler.py: catchup_scan_if_missed() explicitly permits off-hours scoring/display and suppresses another only after a same-IST-day last_scan
code_paths.codec: web/journal_archive_codec.py:pack_raw uses zlib level9 and retains smaller verified envelope
code_paths.report_limit: web/journal_storage.py:iter_latest is bounded to newest20000 archive documents in100-document batches
code_paths.retention: web/db.py labels journal_archive append-only/unbounded; existing closed_history_policy applies exact approved trade fingerprints, not journal TTL

proposed_next_batch.focus: Bound startup/off-hours review work and prepare lossless archive retention
items: Reconcile desired overnight review behavior with once-per-session or completed-daily-input identity; test restart before checkpoint and delayed catch-up without suppressing the next actual trading session.
Preserve selection/gate evidence and all trade-related references; do not solve volume by silently dropping failed checks.
Implement resumable complete archive export with counts/hashes and an independent durable restore check before any separately authorized conditional retention.
Measure daily action bytes on bounded retained metadata and report headroom; retain uncertainty for other applications sharing the cluster.
